name: Nishiwaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nishiwaki city emblem in maroon: a stylised human figure with outstretched arms and a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Nishiwaki, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1952.

features.role: Nishiwaki city emblem — a stylised human figure with outstretched arms and a disc
